解答 方程组两边同时对 $t$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{dt}=f''(t),\quad \frac{dy}{dt}=tf''(t),\quad \text{可得 }\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}=t.$$

方程两边再同时对 $x$ 求导一次，

$$\text{则有 }\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}=\frac{d\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)}{dx}=\frac{d\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)/dt}{dx/dt}=\frac{1}{f''(t)}$$
